subject: TerraNova onboarding — PO issuance request, spend cap, and line item fix
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@terranovasys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@terranovasys.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: TerraNova onboarding — PO request & spend cap

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, TerraNova is ready to have Redwood issue a purchase order to cover our initial SOW and runrate. Quick summary of what we need from Redwood:

- Formal PO number that we can reference on our AP side
- A spend cap set at $150,000 for Q1 (we may request a higher cap next quarter)
- Correction to line items on the initial invoice: the Support SKU (TN-SUP-03) was omitted and should be listed as a separate line with quantity 12 and unit price $1,250

I've attached the onboarding form and our initial invoice for reference. Please let me know if you need vendor paperwork (W-9 / tax id), or an encrypted SFTP location for sending sensitive docs. Our procurement team is cc'd.

Attachments: [TerraNova_Onboarding_Form.pdf (pdf), TN_initial_invoice.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks,
Sophie Martin
Head of Operations | TerraNova Systems
Sophie.Martin@terranovasys.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@terranovasys.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TerraNova onboarding — PO request & spend cap

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear write-up and for attaching the invoice. We'll run this through procurement and can provision a PO once we have the few remaining items below: 

1) Vendor tax ID (EIN) or completed W-9 attached to the vendor record
2) Signed SOW or the DocuSign link for the work you want covered under the PO
3) Confirmation that the Support SKU should be billed monthly vs one-time (you noted qty 12; we interpret that as 12 months)

If you can drop the W-9 into the Drive link above or email it to secure@redwood.com we'll add it to the vendor profile. I've attached our internal Procurement_Checklist so you can see which fields trigger PO provisioning and which require approvals.

Tentative timeline: if we get the docs by EOD Fri 2/12, Procurement can issue PO within 48 hours (so likely 2/15). PO number format will be PO-2027-#### and it will include the spend cap as an internal ledger limit.

I'll loop Monica on the approval/PO issuance. Grace — can you pre-authorize a $150k spend cap for TN so we can fast-track?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0123

Attachment: [Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@terranovasys.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@terranovasys.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TerraNova onboarding — PO request & spend cap

Karthik,

Thanks — attached is the completed onboarding form (redline applied) and the W-9 (sent to secure@redwood.com via the SFTP earlier this morning). We've also uploaded an updated invoice with the Support SKU listed as TN-SUP-03, quantity 12, unit $1,250 (monthly). Please confirm the line item appears correctly on your end.

I've included a brief note from our finance lead: we prefer the PO to be issued as a single-line cap with an attached schedule that lists the monthly support line separately to make reconciliation easier on our side. If Redwood prefers the support line as a separate line on the PO, that's okay as long as the cap is visible.

Attachments: [TN_line_items_v2.xlsx (xlsx)]

Best,
Sophie

From: monica_patel@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: TerraNova onboarding — PO request & spend cap

Hi Sophie — thanks for sending the W-9 and updated line items. Procurement confirmed the vendor record is complete and Finance pre-authorized the $150,000 Q1 spend cap. We've issued the PO: PO-2027-0784.

Details:
- PO number: PO-2027-0784
- Spend cap (internal ledger limit): $150,000 (Q1)
- Line items: Support SKU TN-SUP-03 is included as a monthly line (qty 12, $1,250/unit) and the SOW schedule is attached for reconciliation
- Next steps for TerraNova: please reference PO-2027-0784 on all invoices submitted for Q1. If you need the PO as a signed PDF, see attached.

Attachment: [PO-2027-0784.pdf (pdf)]

If anything looks off on the PO formatting or the itemization, reply here and we'll reissue quickly. Welcome aboard — looking forward to working together.

Best regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
